rows.sub: Kalshi and Polymarket named by the NBA
League IP plus official Sportradar data

points.sub: The league says others will follow

caption:
The NBA has let prediction markets in, with guardrails.

Kalshi and Polymarket are now the league's preferred prediction market exchanges, with IP rights and official Sportradar data. A CFTC information-sharing agreement came with them. Terms weren't disclosed, and the NBA says more partners are coming.

Also today: DraftKings x NBA, Sokin x Chelsea, Sendwave x Olympique de Marseille, Smart Energy GB x SPFL, Radar Tires x MPBL.

items.title: DraftKings x NBA
items.sub: Official gaming partner, now covering prediction markets

evergreen.caption:
Five names, one league. Here's who the NBA lists as official and preferred in betting and prediction markets.

DraftKings and FanDuel are the official gaming partners, and DraftKings has just widened its deal to cover prediction markets. Kalshi and Polymarket are the preferred prediction market exchanges. In Australia, TAB is the NBA's official betting partner.
